meta.title: the sag decomposition: radial M/L gradient vs matched law vs HI truncation

checks.name: V0 REPRODUCE THE REGISTERED SAG (G036 anchor): mean deep-regime slope -0.13/-0.14 dex/dex, N in [120,155], on the SPARC ingest
checks.reading: same ingest, residual definition and slope fit as G036's V4d; a miss invalidates every downstream comparison

checks.name: A1 GRADIENT-KILL: with ups(r) fitted the population-mean deep sag drops to |mean| < 0.05 dex/dex on BOTH footings
checks.measured: canonical: sag mean -0.1273 -> -0.1648 dex/dex (t = -4.64, p = 7.9e-06); floor 0.0291 -> 0.0296 dex; ups1 median +0.007 +/- 0.273, interior 80%, pinned 23lo/12hi; alt: sag mean -0.1403 -> -0.1647 dex/dex (t = -4.85, p = 3.1e-06); floor 0.0328 -> 0.0339 dex; ups1 median -0.011 +/- 0.256, interior 82%, pinned 24lo/6hi
checks.reading: the pre-registered kill clause (i): the sag's population mean must vanish within errors when the two-parameter gradient model is fitted

checks.name: A2 NOISE-FLOOR PRESERVATION: the within-galaxy deep white-noise floor does not degrade by more than 0.005 dex under the gradient model (pooled offset-removed rms, the registered statistic; median shown too)
checks.reading: a gradient that 'fixes' the sag by eating the noise floor is overfitting, not physics -- the registered 0.045-0.052-dex floor must survive

checks.name: A3 PLAUSIBILITY: > 80% of fitted ups1 interior to [-0.5, +0.5] per Rd
checks.measured: canonical: interior 80% (pinned at bounds: 23 lo / 12 hi of 171); alt: interior 82% (pinned at bounds: 24 lo / 6 hi of 171)
checks.reading: values pinned at the plausibility bound mean the fit wants unphysical gradients -- the candidate then fails its own plausibility clause

checks.name: FINAL VERDICT -- WHICH CANDIDATE OWNS THE SAG
checks.measured: (a) SURVIVES (|mean| after gradient = 0.1647 dex/dex, floor kept = True, plausible = False); (b) immaterial (C-law+gradient min |mean| = 0.1885); (c) immaterial (outer-2-dropped min |mean| = 0.1179)
checks.reading: PRE-REGISTERED ESCALATION: no candidate (gradient, matched law, truncation) reduces the population-mean deep sag to |mean| < 0.05 dex/dex with the white-noise floor intact. The sag is UNEXPLAINED one-sign coherent structure -- the theory's sharpest open anomaly, escalated for the equilibrium account to absorb (candidate (d) EFE is closed at SPARC amplitudes by G036 V4e/G044 V2E).
